data.name: neo.coding.merge.prepare
data.description: Admit a linked coding PR for manual merge using persisted Review/Verify assignments, actual exact-head review, required CI, resolved findings and repository human sign-off. Re-reads the head, records gates and returns a SHA-pinned command; never merges or enables auto-merge.

data.reason: Current Review and Verify assignments on a live linked coding todo are required.

events.limitation: Real merge-prepare RPC and persisted race job; synthetic GitHub, assignments and QA. No real merge, model, harness or deployment. Target instrumentation covers local merge admission and receipt SQL; fixtures are excluded.

mainSql:
SELECT key, value_json FROM pack_facts
      WHERE todo_id = ? AND pack = 'coding' AND key IN (?, ?)

SELECT target, ref, actual_model AS model, actual_effort AS effort,
                follow_anchor AS followAnchor, live_status AS liveStatus,
                started_at AS startedAt, retries, start_interrupted AS startInterrupted,
                needs_you_since AS needsYouSince, claimed_at AS claimedAt
           FROM neo_todo_sessions WHERE todo_id = ?

SELECT fact_json AS fact FROM pack_coding_stage_facts
      WHERE url = ? ORDER BY stage

SELECT scope_key FROM neo_pack_preferences
        WHERE pack = 'coding' AND scope_kind = 'repo' AND scope_key = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND key = ?

SELECT value_json, scope_kind, scope_key, set_by, set_at
